scope_statement: Incremental 0.2 implementation audit against retained Android/platform-independent original features. No blanket parity or release-readiness claim. Historical ledger status/gap strings are not current findings.

coverage.meaning_of_reviewed: Current grouped source paths and relevant tests inspected at the evidence granularity shown below; not exhaustive execution or every original sub-behavior. Cast carries prior review only as explicitly marked.

known_cast_blockers.title: An initial pending Cast preparation survives a source change and loads the old source
known_cast_blockers.failure_path: _prepareCastMedia snapshots the old payload and subtitle text before awaiting the factory. During this initial preparation casting is still false. _open changes _source/_episode but neither revokes the pending share nor increments the native Cast revision; its loadCast call is guarded by _casting. When the old factory completes, mounted/ownsSystem/shareGeneration still pass, so its lease is retained and the old payload is sent to castLoad. The decoder for the newly selected source is paused and the receiver loads the previous source. The equivalent stale snapshot occurs if subtitles are disabled during initial preparation: _setSubtitles does not invalidate/reload while _casting is false.

known_cast_blockers.title: Disconnect while the local pause is pending leaves previously playing local media paused
known_cast_blockers.failure_path: After preparation, _runCastLoad awaits local('pause'). A disconnect during that await increments _castRevision and revokes, but does not resume because casting has not yet become true. When pause completes, the stale-revision branch at lines 228-230 revokes and returns without restoring local playback. The disconnect restoration later in the post-castLoad branch is never reached. No castLoad needs to be sent for this failure.

known_cast_blockers.title: A failed asynchronous Cast load overrides a newer user pause
known_cast_blockers.failure_path: The load captures wasPlaying before preparation and native loading. A user pause during the pending load correctly updates _loadPlayState=false and pauses the local decoder because casting is not true yet. If castLoad then rejects or throws, the catch path restores from the old wasPlaying value instead of _loadPlayState, issuing local play against the user's newer pause. The inverse case also discards a newer play request when the attempt began paused.

known_cast_blockers.title: Selecting an existing subtitle track leaves the previous external text selected for Cast
known_cast_blockers.failure_path: File/service subtitle loaders record their decoded text in _subtitleText. The actual existing-track selection handler only calls _player.setSubtitleTrack(track); it neither updates/clears _subtitleText and _subtitleUrl nor refreshes Cast. Selecting an embedded/different/no track therefore leaves the old external subtitle text in the Cast payload. On a subsequent Cast request, _prepareCastMedia converts and shares that old text even though it is no longer the selected local track. During an active Cast session, the selection does not alter remote subtitles at all.

other_confirmed_missing_or_broken.summary: Persisted Stretch video-fit option is accepted and exposed, but playback renders it as contain.
other_confirmed_missing_or_broken.symbol_or_failure_path: SettingsPage saves videoFit=fill; _PlayerPageState._applyOptions sets _fill only for cover; Video.fit is _fill ? BoxFit.cover : BoxFit.contain, so fill can never become BoxFit.fill.
other_confirmed_missing_or_broken.actionable_acceptance: Preserve the selected fit mode through the real Video rendering dispatch, or remove the unsupported offered mode explicitly; verify persisted fill does not silently behave as contain.
other_confirmed_missing_or_broken.verification: Direct static value-flow proof. Existing fit engine test covers cover/contain, not the offered fill branch; no execution performed.

other_confirmed_missing_or_broken.summary: Automatic last-known trusted configuration fallback/request recovery is not implemented; current code only keeps an in-memory default/base and offers manual retry.
other_confirmed_missing_or_broken.symbol_or_failure_path: ApiService.initialize catches discovery failure and returns; _request immediately converts network/timeouts into ApiException with no bounded recovery path; AppState persists the private library/settings but no last-known verified API base.

original_evidence.observation: Original checks saved reachable base, downloads config, then falls back to saved/default and records reachability/source.

other_confirmed_missing_or_broken.actionable_acceptance: Either retain this as an explicitly documented constrained-policy divergence, or implement bounded recovery using only already-trusted verified configuration. Do not add guessed domains, weaken trust validation or retry authorization denials.
other_confirmed_missing_or_broken.verification: Confirmed static absence of saved-base/fallback orchestration and transport retry. No server outage or live domain probes attempted; this is not an assertion that the current trusted server is unavailable.

summary.conclusion: Most historically absent priority groups now have concrete 0.2 code/test evidence. Independent share-app remains absent, offered fill/stretch is ignored by rendering, and trusted configuration fallback/recovery remains incomplete. This is not full parity.
